anchors.description: Vertical distance from the floor at the base of the left wooden desk cabinet to the front edge of its top surface (desk working height).
anchors.visible_evidence: Left desk has a drawer cabinet with metal pulls and a black laminate top carrying a radio; the top front edge and the floor line where the cabinet meets the wooden floor are both visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US dorm/office desk height is standardized at 29-30 in (0.74-0.76 m); interval allows a slightly taller cabinet or a raised shelf top.

anchors.description: Horizontal width of the chair's padded backrest between its left and right visible outer edges at mid-height.
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark gray upholstered task-chair backrest viewed from behind, with left and right outer edges clearly visible above the seat and below the desk edge.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No brand or model visible; typical armless task-chair back width is 0.44-0.50 m, with chairs varying up to about 0.52 m.

anchors.description: Diameter of the plastic wastebasket's top rim measured between its leftmost and rightmost rim points.
anchors.visible_evidence: Tapered white/light-blue plastic wastebasket standing between the chair and the desk pedestal; full top rim ellipse and body down to the floor are visible (its mirror reflection on the right is a separate image, not used).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Generic unbranded wastebasket; top diameters of such bins range roughly 0.23-0.33 m.
